title: Child grant exceeds parent scope
description: Synthetic case: parent can read resource-A only; child is issued read+write on A.
policy_assumptions: Parent effective grant is read-only on resource-A.
Child's presented delegation includes write, which exceeds the parent's grant.
Effective child authority must be attenuated by parent authority.

expected.rationale: Child authority must not exceed the parent's permitted scope.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
